definitions.clicks: clicks on controls, including the click into each text field
definitions.textEntries: blocks of typed text (one per field)
definitions.scrolls: controls that were below or above the visible area when needed (one scroll each)
definitions.missing: steps the script could not find (control absent or renamed)
